QuestInfo.name: Attendance Check
QuestInfo.0: I wonder what #b#p9200000##k will give me if I give him these items I collected for the last 2 weeks.
QuestInfo.1: I came to MapleStory everyday and collected all the scrumptious lunch items. From what I hear, it has something to do with the 5 types of snacks I collected...
QuestInfo.2: I gave #b#p9200000##k the lunch snacks I had collected for 14 days. Hope they didn't rot! Anyways, he seemed ecstatic and gave me a cool lunchbox that can be used as a weapon.

0.0: Hey! Did you come to MapleStory everyday starting September 11th?

yes.0: I applaud your persistence! You're a treasured Mapler indeed.

no.0: Oh...I guess you're not ready to exchange your snacks. Hope you're not planning on eating it all!

1.0: Here is your prize. It's a Lunch Box Weapon. The monsters shouldn't under estimate the power of a little lunch box!

item.0: Nope, can't give you the prize. Check if you met all the requirements.
